boot_load_lifecycle.action: Stock storage and UI initialization complete. Do not add an early boot hook.
At a separately proven post-storage hook, read only the small A/B headers with 0x02004870.
Validate bounds, magic, version, committed state, sequence, payload length, and CRC before touching owned Ch10 RAM.
Read the selected payload into scratch or inactive owned RAM, verify again, then publish valid and generation last.
Note On and Note Off select the same immutable slot and generation. No loader, storage I/O, or global bank switch occurs in the Note path.
Missing or corrupt records leave valid clear and fall back safely to stock or explicit host-loaded volatile data.

crc_and_repack.layout_change: Changing app.bin size, JLFS VM/USRFLASH offsets or sizes, or UFW flash.bin size is outside the validated fixed-layout packer and is blocked.
crc_and_repack.runtime_persistence: No FWSC, UFW, SFC, app.bin, or JLFS-directory CRC changes when firmware writes an already allocated VM or USRFLASH range at runtime. The custom record still needs its own integrity and commit checks.

persistence_regions_outside_ufw_flash_bi.implication: Runtime writes there do not alter the v15 FWSC flash.bin entry. The directory capacity alone does not prove unused allocation space or identify which region backs obj+0x160.

full_stock_0xa3.warning: Do not change the stock 0xa3 schema or overwrite the existing 128-record library for custom mapping metadata.

reference_only.status: smallest format, but deterministic boot materialization and lifecycle side effects are not yet proven

runtime_voice_0x9c.preferred_first_persistent_payload: 16 exact H2-proven runtime voices, after a storage allocation is proven

format.atomicity: two 0x1000-aligned copies for the 16-slot set, payload first and commit header last, then readback verification
format.payload_kind: 16 exact 0x9c runtime voices first, not a modified stock 0xa3 record

recommended_persistent_design_after_gate.power_loss: On any short write, invalid CRC, torn header, or ambiguous sequence, retain the previous valid copy and expose volatile fallback rather than SAVED.
recommended_persistent_design_after_gate.read_contract: Use 0x02004870 only after storage initialization. Accept only exact magic/version/length/slot count/CRC and a fully committed newest sequence.
recommended_persistent_design_after_gate.storage: a separately proven allocation in the runtime storage region, outside every stock allocation and journal range
recommended_persistent_design_after_gate.write_contract: Treat 0x02004b02 success only when return equals requested length. Never copy stock SAVE behavior that ignores failure.

residual_unknowns: Which JLFS region and suballocation obj+0x160 actually names at runtime
The runtime value of the storage bound at 0x01c454b0+0x18
All allocations and journal ranges after stock patch offset +0x9209
Exact erase, open, and commit semantics of 0x02004a54 modes
A proven post-storage boot hook that is safe on every boot path

rollback_boundaries.firmware: H2 itself changes exact app sectors 0x04000, 0x20000, 0x22000, 0x2a000, and 0x62000. Any future persistence implementation needs a new exact changed-sector inventory and rollback bundle.
rollback_boundaries.persistent_data: The official UFW flash.bin stops at 0x9c000, before VM and USRFLASH. Restoring official app sectors does not prove deletion of a custom persistent record.
rollback_boundaries.safe_rollback_rule: Official firmware must ignore the custom namespace after app rollback. Prefer version rejection or a separately guarded tombstone operation. Never erase a broad VM or USRFLASH region without a proven allocation map.
rollback_boundaries.stock_save: Restore stock packer and SAVE bytes before claiming stock Patch SAVE compatibility. A rollback from a custom build must restore both code and any modified stock data records independently.

safe_options_now.reason: Extends H2/R04 without touching persistent storage. Boot fallback is stock or invalid-until-loaded.

safe_options_now.option: reuse stock 128 patch records as the patch library and keep a volatile note-to-record map
safe_options_now.reason: No new persistent bytes. It preserves stock record format and avoids loader calls in the Note hot path after slots are preloaded.

safe_options_now.option: piggyback custom data into stock SAVE records, flags, or selection bytes
safe_options_now.reason: Those bytes have exact stock meanings and failure behavior. Repurposing them corrupts stock compatibility and rollback.

stock_patch_store.why_zero: No official-v15 evidence proves that bytes after +0x9209 are unallocated, that obj+0x160 equals the start of VM or USRFLASH, or that no stock allocator/journal uses the remainder.
